2. Heard the learned Advocate for the applicant-petitioners. The learned Advocate keeping harmony with the contents of the application submits that the instant civil revision was preferred by the defendant -petitioners against the judgment and decree dated 07.10.1999 passed by the Sub-ordinate Judge, 2nd  Court, Mymensingh in Other Class Appeal no. 161 of 1992 reversing the judgment and decree dated 27.07.1992 passed by the Additional Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Mymensingh in Other Class Suit no. 13 of 1992 dismissing the said suit. 

 3. He further submits that this Court issued the Rule on 12.12.1999 calling upon the opposite party nos. 1-3 to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and decree dated 07.10.1999 should not be set aside and by the said Rule issuance order the operation of the impugned judgment and decree was stayed for 6(six) months from date. The IP matter was posted in the daily. 6ause list of the Court no. 1(Annex) for hearing and when the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned Advocate for the petitioners was not found available, as such, the Rule was discharged for default on 15.07.2014. 

 8. In fact, the petitioners filling this revisional application obtained stay order as to the operation of the impugned judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court below in favour of the plaintiff-opposite parties. The whole attention of the petitioners appears to have concentrated as to how they can frustrate the operation of the judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court below in order to deprive the plaintiffs opposite parties from enjoying the benefit of the said decree. As a result, it is evident from the record that from the date of filing of the revisional application in 1999 within the last 15 years. Till 15.07.2014 the petitioners had mentioned the matter for hearing once while the opposite parties have been trying continuously for hearing of the Rule. So, the ground taken in the present petition for restoration that the clerk had failed to bring it into the notice of the learned Advocate about the fixation of the matter for hearing is not believable and cannot be taken as fact and this submissions and ground are not consistent and compatible with the previous conduct of the petitioners. The record shows that the petitioners were in habit to drag the hearing of the Rule as such they did not take step at any point of time for hearing of the Rule and to make the Rule pending for more several years the petitioners have come again with this petition of restoration of the Rule. 

 9. In my consideration had the petitioners any interest and intention for hearing of the Rule he could have taken effective step and effort after the restoration of the Rule previously in 2009. After the said restoration in 2009 the petitioners did not take any step within the last 5 years for hearing of the Rule. The petitioners capitalizing the stay order against the impugned judgment and decree under the garb of the present Rule successfully had resisted the opposite parties from enjoying the benefit of the said decree but there should not be any more indulgence from this Court to the said nefarious act of the petitioners. So, there is no any scope to take the submission of the learned Advocate of the petitioners that if the Rule is restored they will be vigilant for the hearing of the Rule. When the restoration of Rule is sought for with a motive having no good intention to dispose of the Rule rather to cause harm to the adversary making the Rule pending for an indefinite period, this Court should negate the same stoutly.
